idea-plugin.name: HDC Wi-Fi
idea-plugin.description:
Manage HarmonyOS / OpenHarmony devices over Wi-Fi from the IDE — like ADB WiFi, but for HDC (hdc tconn / hdc tconn -remove).
  • Visual device panel: add, connect, disconnect and forget devices by IP:port, with connection history
  • Per-device connection state (Connected / Connecting / Failed / Not connected) with the failure reason on hover
  • On-demand local-network scan that derives the real network range from each interface's netmask and probes multiple ports per host, so devices on random Wi-Fi debugging ports are found
  • Auto-refresh with quick interval choices (Off / 5s / 10s / 30s / 60s) and a last-updated timestamp
  • Optional serial auto-connect for saved or newly discovered devices (off by default)
  • Device information panel with HarmonyOS / OpenHarmony system summary, product model, brand, software and API version
  • Shell command runner per device
  • File send/receive (push/pull) with live output
  • hilog viewer with keyword filter, pause and auto-scroll
  • Simplified Chinese interface with compact device rows, contextual progress and inline error feedback
The HDC binary path is fully configurable under Settings > Tools > HDC Wi-Fi (auto-detected from DevEco Studio / OpenHarmony / HarmonyOS SDK locations and PATH).
